limitations: All loaded meshes are retained, but unselected source tiles may contain missing occluders or shadow casters.
Input selection bounds are not a certificate of visible coverage or source completeness.
Building feature IDs and depth, normal, silhouette and semantic guides are not exported yet.
Photographic shadows, mixed LOD and terrain alignment require source review.
Context meshes retain original elevations. Road/terrain overlap, water visibility and source edition alignment require review; no corrective height shift was invented.
Vegetation crowns are artistic representations of mapped points or woodland fill, not surveyed tree geometry or measured heights.

limitations: Unapproved structural art-direction studies, not finished illustrations.
All candidates use exactly the same loaded source meshes and camera as the new unstyled reference.
Ground photography is replaced with a palette. Context appears only where supplied; transportation is not subdivided into unverified rail/road types.
Roof/facade classification is a deterministic shader rule on shading-normal Z, not source semantic roof labels.
Procedural window marks and palette choices are artistic treatments, not measured facade details.
Mapped vegetation may use interpreted canopy shapes; source attribution and representation limits are retained separately.
No final art direction, terrain alignment or real-world completeness is approved by this pilot.
